title: 第13章 被人陷害第14章 他不能管那我能吗
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “出事了，出事了！青哥，青哥！”
一个素未谋面的小太监慌慌张张地跑入书阁所在的院子，一进来就开始像周刘培一样呼唤着李叶青。
书阁中正在读书的李叶青突然心下一沉，有种不好的预感，连忙掀开窗户。
“你叫我？”
“您就是刘培说的青哥？请您快快去救他吧，再晚一些，他，他就要没命了！”
“你先把情况和我讲清楚。”
小太监这才开始磕磕巴巴地叙述着事情的经过。
原来，周刘培自从到了御膳房之后牢记李叶青的叮嘱，处处小心谨慎与人为善，也算是度过了最为危险的新人时期，同时由于他向来不与人为难，导致他的人缘也不错。
毕竟没人会讨厌一个明显没什么野心的人。
今天一大早，周刘培按照大师傅的吩咐开始熬煮给各司掌印、提督太监准备的凉茶，毕竟这里天气越来越热，宫里熬煮这一份凉茶，再放入一些冰块，也算是这些大太监的福利。
熬制的过程很顺利，只是等到凉茶熬完，准备冰镇的时候，却出了事情。
负责验毒的太监用银针一测，竟然变得乌黑！
“银针变黑了？！”
李叶青心头猛地一紧，凉茶验出有毒，这在后宫是足以掉脑袋的大罪！
也就是这凉茶是给各司掌印太监喝的，要是涉及到的是各位妃子皇子，甚至于皇帝，周刘培此刻已经坐上刑架被审问，这小太监也没有出来通风报信的机会。
他强压下震惊，沉声追问“具体怎么回事？凉茶熬制过程中有谁经手？验毒的太监是谁的人？”
那小太监急得满头是汗，语速飞快“熬茶的时候一切正常，就刘培哥和俺俩在灶前守着！可、可就在把茶汤舀进冰鉴的当口，王太监带着验毒的小太监过来了！
银针一探进去，立马就黑了！王太监就一口咬定是刘培哥下了毒，现在人已经被捆了，说要直接扭送内官监重办！
要下内牢问话！”
说话的时候，小太监简直就要哭出来了。
内牢是宫中的牢房，专门用来关押犯事的太监宫女，里面用刑审问的也都是太监嬷嬷，周刘培要真是进去了，即便最后查出来与他无关，那他也出不来了！
李叶青大脑飞速梳理着线索。
不对，这事里透着怪异。
这凉茶是为各位女官、太监熬的，在这里面下毒没有任何意义啊。
你要是下毒，也该是下到各位贵妃皇子、甚至帝后的饭菜中才对。
这就代表着，其实真正下毒之人不想要事情闹大，若是下毒在各宫的饭食，那动静太大，反倒会引起注意，可能坏事。
要是各司首领太监的凉茶，那影响就小得多，怎么说还不是靠这些人一张嘴？
“青哥！怎么办啊？内官监那地方，进去不死也得脱层皮！要是再入了内牢，那就出不来了！”
小太监带着哭腔。
时间紧迫，李叶青脑海之中飞速运转。
“你立刻去尚膳监门口盯着，有什么动静马上来报！”
李叶青先支走来报信的小太监，随即转身，毫不犹豫地冲向吴总管在司苑局的直房。
“干爹！出事了！”
李叶青推门而入，言简意赅地将事情说了一遍。
吴总管听完，手指不停地摩挲着手中的茶杯，眼睛微眯。
“儿子啊，我倒是有心帮你，可是尚膳监那边的掌印太监，我也说不上话，就好像咱们面对那些大姑娘小媳妇的时候，有心无力啊。”
“干爹明鉴，”
李叶青语气沉静，目光却锐利，“正因尚膳监水泼不进，儿子才不敢劳动干爹硬闯。此事蹊跷，绝非表面看去那般简单。儿子自己去周旋便是，但需请您帮一个关键忙——务必将此事，火速禀报莲公主殿下。”
“莲公主？我可没这么大的脸去请动这等贵人”
吴总管摩挲茶杯的手一顿，浑浊的眼睛里精光一闪，身体微微前倾，压低了声音。
“好儿子，莫不是让我去以你的名义请动莲公主不成？”
“正是。”
“你是什么时候攀上这根高枝的？”
content_en:
"Something happened, something happened! Brother Qing, Brother Qing!"
A young eunuch who had never met him ran into the courtyard where the bookstore was located in a panic. As soon as he entered, he started calling Li Yeqing like Zhou Liupei.
Li Yeqing, who was studying in the library, suddenly felt his heart sink. He had a bad feeling and quickly opened the window.
"You called me?"
"Are you the Brother Qing that Liu Pei said? Please go and save him quickly. If it's a little later, he, he will be dead!"
"Please explain the situation clearly to me first."
The little eunuch then began to narrate what happened.
It turned out that Zhou Liupei had kept Li Yeqing's advice in mind since he arrived at the imperial dining room, and was always cautious and kind to others. He was able to survive the most dangerous period as a newcomer. At the same time, because he never made things difficult for others, his popularity was also good.
After all, no one dislikes someone who clearly has no ambition.
Early this morning, Zhou Liupei followed the master's instructions and began to brew herbal tea for the eunuchs and eunuchs. After all, the weather here is getting hotter and hotter. The palace brewing this herbal tea and adding some ice cubes is also a benefit for these eunuchs.
The brewing process went smoothly, but when the herbal tea was ready to be chilled, something happened.
The eunuch in charge of the drug test used a silver needle to test it, and it turned black!
"The silver needle turned black?!"
Li Yeqing's heart suddenly tightened. The herbal tea was found to be poisonous. This was a serious crime in the harem that could kill one's head!
That is to say, this herbal tea is for the eunuchs in charge of various departments. If it involves the concubines, princes, or even the emperor, Zhou Liupei is already sitting on the rack and being interrogated, and the little eunuch has no chance to come out and report the news.
He suppressed his shock and asked in a deep voice, "What exactly happened? Who handled the process of brewing the herbal tea? Whose eunuch did the poison testing?"
The little eunuch was so anxious that he was sweating and spoke very fast, "Everything was normal when the tea was brewing. Only Brother Liu Pei and I were guarding in front of the stove! But, just as he was scooping the tea soup into the ice pan, Eunuch Wang came over with the little eunuch who was doing the poison testing!
As soon as the silver needle went in, it turned black immediately! Eunuch Wang insisted that Brother Liu Pei had poisoned him. Now that he had been tied up, he said that he would be sent directly to the Internal Affairs Bureau for severe punishment!
We need to go to jail for questioning! "
As he spoke, the little eunuch almost burst into tears.
The inner prison is a cell in the palace, specially used to detain the eunuchs and maids who committed crimes. The eunuchs who were tortured and interrogated inside were also the eunuchs. If Zhou Liupei really went in, even if it was found that it had nothing to do with him, he would not be able to get out!
Li Yeqing's brain quickly sorted out the clues.
No, there's something weird about this.
This herbal tea is made for all the female officials and eunuchs. There is no point in poisoning it.
If you were to poison, you should put it into the meals of the concubines, princes, and even the emperor and empress.
This means that in fact, the person who actually poisoned the food does not want to make a big deal out of it. If the food in each palace is poisoned, the noise will be too great, but it will attract attention, which may cause bad things.
If the herbal tea is given by the eunuchs who are the leaders of each department, the impact will be much smaller. How can it be said that it does not rely on the mouths of these people?
"Brother Qing! What should I do? In the inner prison, you will have to shed your skin even if you don't die! If you enter the inner prison again, you won't be able to get out!"
The little eunuch was crying.
Time was running out, and Li Yeqing's mind was racing.
"You immediately go to the door of Shangshan Prison and keep an eye on it. If there is any movement, report it immediately!"
Li Yeqing first sent away the little eunuch who came to report the news, then turned around and rushed to Manager Wu's room in Siyuan Bureau without hesitation.
"Godfather! Something happened!"
Li Yeqing pushed the door open and explained the matter concisely and concisely.
After listening to this, Mr. Wu kept stroking the tea cup in his hand with his fingers and narrowed his eyes slightly.
"Son, I really want to help you, but I can't say anything to the eunuch who is in charge of the Shangshan Supervisor. It's like we are powerless when facing those big girls and young wives."
"Godfather Mingjian,"
Li Yeqing's tone was calm, but his eyes were sharp, "It is precisely because the water in Shangshan Prison cannot be poured in that my son did not dare to force his godfather to break in. This matter is strange and is not as simple as it seems on the surface. My son can just deal with it on his own, but I need you to do a crucial favor - be sure to report this matter to Her Royal Highness Princess Lian as soon as possible."
"Princess Lian? I don't have the nerve to invite such a noble person."
Manager Wu's hand stroking the tea cup paused, his cloudy eyes flashed, his body leaned forward slightly, and he lowered his voice.
"Good son, why don't you ask me to please Princess Lian in your name?"
"Exactly."
"When did you climb this high branch?"
title_en: Chapter 13: Being framed Chapter 14: If he can’t take care of it, can I?
